marta (People Ops): quick draft of a 'micro-feedback' pack for the review window. goal: short, copy/paste-ready lines for peers + fast anchors for managers. dropping the pack here for a sanity check.

ops-bot: reminder 72h left to prepare calibration notes. Submit via https://handbook/self-review or attach to your review doc.

jack (Eng): love it. can we get 1-2 concrete behavioral anchors for each level? those make calibrations so much faster.

noah (PM): also please include a tiny IC vs manager phrasing note so product folks don't conflate scope.

marta (People Ops): good calls added both. full pack below (copyable):

--- MICRO-FEEDBACK 1-LINER (peer) ---
- "Worked with X to unblock Y; delivered a doc + follow-up that prevented repeated support tickets."
- Use: give once-line impact + one quick behavior if possible.

--- MICRO-FEEDBACK TEMPLATE (60s peer swap) ---
1) One-line impact: "X did Y, outcome Z."
2) One-sentence why it mattered: customer/team/business effect
3) One quick suggestion (optional): concrete next step or ask

--- BEHAVIORAL ANCHORS (manager quick-pills) ---
- Raise: "Consistently delivers high-impact outcomes, mentors others, and leads cross-team initiatives (examples: shipped A that moved metric B by +X)."
- Keep: "Meets expectations with reliable delivery, owns scoped work, occasionally mentors peers."
- Lower: "Missed key deliverables or repeatedly relied on others to unblock; needs coaching on prioritization."

(brief note: for managers, swap "delivers" with "enables" when writing anchors for people managers -- e.g., 'enables team to deliver...' )

--- IC vs MANAGER PHRASE TIP ---
- IC line: focus on personal contributions + technical/operational outcome ("Implemented X; reduced latency by 30%.")
- Manager line: focus on team outcomes, enablement, and direction ("Coached team to reduce incident MTTR; hired two engineers; set roadmap for Q3.")

--- CALIBRATION MATRIX (30s glance) ---
- Signal 1: Outcome (metric / customer feedback / launch)
- Signal 2: Scope (feature, cross-team program, org-level)
- Signal 3: Consistency (one-off vs repeated behavior)
- Quick rule: higher rating needs 2/3 strong signals + concrete evidence links

--- ASYNC ACCESSIBILITY TIP ---
- If you leave feedback asynchronously, prefix with [ASYNC] and include 1-line context + 1-line ask.

--- EXAMPLE (copyable) ---
Peer: "X redesigned signup flow; result: 22% increase in activation. Evidence: PR 502, dashboard /d/56/activation. Suggestion: add a short onboarding checklist for mobile."
Manager anchor: "Keep (Delivered consistent launches, owns PR reviews; evidence: PR 488, monthly release notes)"

--- END PACK ---

mari (Manager): this is great. can we add a one-line note about timezone-friendly peer swaps? i.e., 'leave feedback within 48h to be included in calibration'

marta (People Ops): yup adding: "Please leave peer micro-feedback within 48h of working together to ensure it's considered in calibration."

jack (Eng): :thumbsup: super practical. i'll paste into our team doc.

noah (PM): small nit: in the behavioral anchors, can we add an "example evidence" fragment like 'dashboard link / PR #' to make copy/paste frictionless?

marta (People Ops): good point added a short parenthetical after each anchor pointing to evidence examples. thanks! planning to land this in the handbook under /handbook/self-review/micro-feedback.md and ping folks tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: noted Self-review materials updated by marta (People Ops). File: /handbook/self-review/micro-feedback.md

mari (Manager): thanks marta this should speed up calibration conversations a lot.
